steps.template_en: 'Logistic regression = logit transform Y.' WRONG! Logistic models log-ODDS. Y is BINARY. Y~Bernoulli(p), model log(p/(1-p))=Xβ. We model PROBABILITY through LINK FUNCTION.
steps.template_zh: '逻辑回归=logit变换Y。'错！Y二元，Y~Bernoulli(p)，通过连接函数建模概率。

steps.template_en: GLM = distribution + link function. (1) RANDOM: Y~Exponential Family. (2) SYSTEMATIC: η=Xβ. (3) LINK: g(μ)=η where μ=E[Y]. Link connects mean to linear predictor.
steps.template_zh: GLM=分布+连接函数。连接函数将均值连接到线性预测器。

steps.template_en: Common GLMs: (1) Linear: Normal, identity. (2) Logistic: Binomial, logit. (3) Poisson: Poisson, log. (4) Gamma: Gamma, inverse. Each natural for the data type.
steps.template_zh: 常见GLM：(1)线性：恒等。(2)逻辑：logit。(3)泊松：log。(4)Gamma：倒数。

steps.template_en: Estimation via IRLS: compute working weights and response at each step, fit weighted LS. Converges rapidly. Deviance = -2log-likelihood ratio, generalizes residual SS.
steps.template_zh: 通过IRLS估计：每步计算工作权重和响应，拟合加权最小二乘。快速收敛。偏差=-2对数似然比。

steps.template_en: For a binary outcome: (1) Fit logistic: glm(y~x, family=binomial). (2) Interpret coefficients as log-odds ratios. (3) Compute odds ratios. (4) Predict probabilities. (5) Check goodness-of-fit: deviance residuals.
steps.template_zh: 二分类结果：(1)拟合逻辑回归。(2)解释系数为log-比值比。(3)计算比值比。(4)预测概率。(5)检查拟合优度。

steps.template_en: GLMs UNIFY linear, logistic, Poisson, Gamma regression under one framework. They're the workhorse of applied statistics. Modern extensions: GAMs (smooth terms), GLMMs (random effects), zero-inflated models.
steps.template_zh: GLM在线性、逻辑、泊松、Gamma回归下统一。现代扩展：GAM(平滑项)、GLMM(随机效应)、零膨胀模型。
